description: The class of the airspace at a field's surface, from the NASR Class Airspace volumes whose shape holds it: B, C or D (14 CFR 71.41, 71.51, 71.61) or E (a surface area or an extension to one, 71.71(b), AIM 3-2-6e1 and e2) where a volume of that class reaches the ground (a floor at SFC, 0 ft AGL, or an MSL floor at or under the field's elevation), the most restrictive where they overlap; G where none does (AIM 3-3-1). A Class B or C shelf over the field is not its surface class. Part-time where every volume of that class is in effect by NOTAM or by remark (NASR WKHR_CODE NOTAM or RMK, not H24); then `otherwise` is the class at other times, the next class reaching the surface or G (AIM 3-2-5a1: "other times CLASS E" or "other times CLASS G"). A volume with no code is read as full-time.

elevation_ft.description: The field's elevation, feet MSL (NASR APT_BASE ELEV).

hours.description: NASR's WKHR_CODE: H24, NOTAM or RMK.

otherwise.description: The class at other times where it is part-time; null where it is not.

otherwise_part_time.description: That class is part-time too: G at the times neither is in effect.
